name: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5
authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology
description: Security and privacy controls for information systems and organizations, organized into control families for risk-based tailoring.

requirements.title: Access Control
requirements.description: Limit information system access to authorized users, processes, and devices and enforce approved flows.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the approved access policy and role design, then inspect current access review evidence and exceptions.

requirements.title: Awareness and Training
requirements.description: Ensure personnel understand security and privacy responsibilities and receive role-based training.
requirements.verification_guidance: Provide the approved training policy, course assignments, completion records, and overdue remediation.

requirements.title: Audit and Accountability
requirements.description: Create, protect, review, and retain audit records sufficient to support accountability and investigation.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the audit policy and use Splunk tracking to demonstrate source coverage, freshness, review, and retention.

requirements.title: Assessment, Authorization, and Monitoring
requirements.description: Assess controls, authorize systems, and monitor control effectiveness over time.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the authorization and assessment records, then verify the monitoring output is current and tied to owners.

requirements.title: Configuration Management
requirements.description: Establish and maintain baseline configurations and control changes to systems and components.
requirements.verification_guidance: Use a current configuration dashboard or saved search to show baseline drift, changes, and unresolved exceptions.

requirements.title: Contingency Planning
requirements.description: Prepare for, respond to, and recover from system disruptions and failures.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the approved continuity plan and attach a recent exercise or restore test that demonstrates it works.

requirements.title: Identification and Authentication
requirements.description: Identify and authenticate users, devices, and processes before access is granted.
requirements.verification_guidance: Use identity or authentication tracking to demonstrate coverage, exceptions, and recent successful test events.

requirements.title: Incident Response
requirements.description: Prepare for, detect, analyze, contain, eradicate, and recover from incidents.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the response plan and confirm it is supported by incident records, alert history, and an exercise or actual response.

requirements.title: Maintenance
requirements.description: Perform controlled and monitored maintenance on organizational systems.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the maintenance procedure and sample records or logs for authorization, monitoring, and completion.

requirements.title: Media Protection
requirements.description: Protect system media, including digital and non-digital media, through handling, access, and disposal controls.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the approved media handling and disposal policy, inventory, access restrictions, and completed disposal records.

requirements.title: Physical and Environmental Protection
requirements.description: Limit physical access and protect facilities, systems, and supporting infrastructure from environmental threats.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the approved physical security procedure and current access, visitor, environmental, and test records.

requirements.title: Planning
requirements.description: Develop and maintain security and privacy plans that describe the system, controls, roles, and operating assumptions.
requirements.verification_guidance: Provide current approved plans with system scope, control responsibilities, assumptions, exceptions, and review dates. The plan must match the deployed system.

requirements.title: Program Management
requirements.description: Manage organization-wide security and privacy programs, risk, policy, and oversight.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the approved program charter, risk register, governance decisions, assigned owners, and evidence of periodic review.

requirements.title: Personnel Security
requirements.description: Manage personnel risk before, during, and after employment or contract assignments.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the approved personnel security procedure and sample onboarding, transfer, and termination records.

requirements.title: Personally Identifiable Information Processing and Transparency
requirements.description: Manage personally identifiable information processing and provide appropriate transparency and privacy protections.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review current privacy notices, data inventory, processing purpose, retention, and privacy impact documentation.

requirements.title: Risk Assessment
requirements.description: Assess, document, and monitor security and privacy risks to organizational operations and individuals.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the current risk assessment and register, then verify material risks have owners, treatment decisions, and tracking evidence.

requirements.title: System and Services Acquisition
requirements.description: Integrate security and privacy requirements into acquisition, development, and supplier management.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review procurement and development requirements, then sample supplier or project records for applied security and privacy criteria.

requirements.title: System and Communications Protection
requirements.description: Protect system boundaries, communications, and information flows using approved architectural and technical safeguards.
requirements.verification_guidance: Use network and configuration tracking to show protected flows, encryption coverage, boundary controls, and exceptions.

requirements.title: System and Information Integrity
requirements.description: Identify, report, and correct flaws, malicious code, improper use, and unauthorized changes.
requirements.verification_guidance: Use Splunk tracking to show vulnerability, malware, integrity, and remediation status for in-scope systems.

requirements.title: Supply Chain Risk Management
requirements.description: Identify, assess, and manage risks introduced by suppliers, services, products, and system components.
requirements.verification_guidance: Review the approved supply chain process, supplier inventory, assessment results, contract requirements, and exception decisions.
